text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d the l-o-g-i-n p-a-g-e u-r-l-s and the c-r-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e to r-u-n s-c-r-i-p-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g l-o-g f-i-l-e-s a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-c-e-s-s l-i-m-i-t r-e-v-i-e-w.
2) the actor t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-r-e-d the g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d v-a-l-u-e-s via the a-p-i k-e-y-s and the t-o-k-e-n s-t-o-r-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e-s a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-a-l-a-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-y s-t-e-p.
3) the actor m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e-d the p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e h-i-s-t-o-r-y with the u-s-e-r-a-g-e-n-t o-v-e-r-r-i-d-e and the r-e-f-e-r-r-e-r h-e-a-d-e-r, l-e-a-v-i-n-g n-e-t-w-o-r-k c-a-p-t-u-r-e-s a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-o-m-a-l-y d-e-t-e-c-t r-u-n.
4) the actor a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-c-o-r-d in the i-c-c f-o-l-d-e-r and the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-e-a-l e-n-t-r-y a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
5) the actor n-o-t-e-d the c-l-o-s-e d-a-t-e in the t-i-c-k-e-t m-e-t-a and the s-t-a-t-u-s f-l-a-g, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-l-o-s-u-r-e m-e-m-o a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-o-s-t-m-o-r-t-e-m l-e-v-e-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
